newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Thin Russian MinFins track firmer US bonds.
newsitem.headline: Thin Russian MinFins track firmer US bonds.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds firmed in thin trading on Friday following higher U.S. Treasuries and position-squaring on one of the last trading days of 1996, dealers said.

They added the market, closing earlier these days ahead of year-end holidays, was unaffected by news the State Duma lower house of the Russian parliament approved the second reading of the draft 1997 budget.
Dealers said very little trading was likely next week due to Christmas holidays in the West and the few remaining banks were squaring final positions and fulfilling last client orders.

"The market is feeling better than yesterday mainly due to to stronger U.S. Treasuries... Otherwise, MinFins are looking cheap now. But for the (forthcoming) holidays, it would be a good time to take positions" Eurobank dealer Olivier Coursault said.
